gradient_history.scope: Global DDP-averaged gradient norm BEFORE clipping. Approximately every ten updates plus phase boundaries. Sampling is not a complete clipping-frequency trace; rank-zero NLL is not analyzed as a generalization gap. Branch-only compute endpoints excluded.

application_gradients.scope: Three fixed natural TRAIN prefixes; FP32 partial derivatives by application at unchanged seed23 checkpoint; no optimizer update. Correlation is not a causal test of sharing.

state_probe_specification.selection: Four length>=512 documents/domain from first100 actual domain training-order documents; first four ID-sorted qualifying curve DEV documents/domain. First512 targets; BOS; isolated document format in both splits.
state_probe_specification.gradient_selection: First frozen TRAIN document/domain; seed23 terminal recurrent model; split each repeated core use into equal-weight copies only for gradient measurement
state_probe_specification.scope: Descriptive fixed-prefix diagnosis, not population TRAIN NLL or a new primary outcome; no TEST, model update or LR selection

scope: Exploratory fixed DEV readouts, unchanged weights and positions. Seed and source-group intervals are separate; no inference claim from an untrained path alone.

specification.precision: FP32 CPU independent model, FP64 log normalization
specification.scope: Read-only TRAIN context intervention; original tokens, positions, targets and loss masks retained; no synthetic corpus

unroll_development.scope: Fixed small DEV prefix panel, not full DEV. Truncated one-pass readout is outside the two-pass training configuration. Shows learned dependence, not a reusable iterative algorithm or an advantage over ordinary.
